section-1-1.WHEN: a court determines any question with respect to— (a) the upbringing of a child; or (b) the administration of a child’s property or the application of any income arising from it

section-1-2.TO: have regard to the general principle that any delay in determining the question is likely to prejudice the welfare of the child
section-1-2.IN: any proceedings in which any question with respect to the upbringing of a child arises

section-1-2A.TO: presume that involvement of that parent in the life of the child concerned will further the child's welfare
section-1-2A.IN: the circumstances mentioned in subsection (4)(a) or (7)

section-1-3.TO: have regard in particular to— (a) the ascertainable wishes and feelings of the child concerned (considered in the light of his age and understanding); (b) his physical, emotional and educational needs; (c) the likely effect on him of any change in his circumstances; (d) his age, sex, background and any characteristics of his which the court considers relevant; (e) any harm which he has suffered or is at risk of suffering; (f) how capable each of his parents, and any other person in relation to whom the court considers the question to be relevant, is of meeting his needs; (g) the range of powers available to the court under this Act in the proceedings in question

section-1-5.TO: make one or more orders under this Act with respect to a child
section-1-5.WHERE: the court is considering whether or not to make the order or any of the orders
section-1-5.UNLESS: it considers that doing so would be better for the child than making no order at all

section-2-1.TO: each have parental responsibility for the child
section-2-1.WHEN: they were married to, or civil partners of, each other at the time of the child's birth

section-2-1A.FOR: the child's mother and the other parent
section-2-1A.TO: each have parental responsibility for the child
section-2-1A.WHERE: a child - (a) has a parent by virtue of section 42 of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 2008; or (b) has a parent by virtue of section 43 of that Act and is a person to whom section 1(3) of the Family Law Reform Act 1987 applies

section-2-2.TO: have parental responsibility for the child
section-2-2.WHERE: a child’s father and mother were not married to, or civil partners of, each other at the time of his birth

section-2-2.TO: have parental responsibility for the child
section-2-2.WHERE: a child’s father and mother were not married to, or civil partners of, each other at the time of his birth
section-2-2.IF: he has acquired it (and has not ceased to have it) in accordance with the provisions of this Act

section-2-2A.TO: have parental responsibility for the child
section-2-2A.WHERE: a child has a parent by virtue of section 43 of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 2008 and is not a person to whom section 1(3) of the Family Law Reform Act 1987 applies

section-2-2A.FOR: the other parent of the child
section-2-2A.TO: have parental responsibility for the child
section-2-2A.WHERE: a child has a parent by virtue of section 43 of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 2008 and is not a person to whom section 1(3) of the Family Law Reform Act 1987 applies
section-2-2A.IF: she has acquired parental responsibility for the child (and has not ceased to have it) in accordance with the provisions of this Act

section-2-5.TO: have parental responsibility for the same child at the same time

section-2-7.FOR: a person with parental responsibility for a child
section-2-7.TO: act alone and without the other (or others) in meeting that responsibility
section-2-7.WHERE: more than one person has parental responsibility for a child

section-2-8.FOR: a person who has parental responsibility for a child
section-2-8.TO: act in any way which would be incompatible with any order made with respect to the child under this Act
section-2-8.WHERE: a person has parental responsibility for a child

section-2-9.FOR: a person who has parental responsibility for a child
section-2-9.TO: surrender or transfer any part of that responsibility to another

section-2-9.FOR: a person who has parental responsibility for a child
section-2-9.TO: arrange for some or all of that responsibility to be met by one or more persons acting on his behalf

section-2-10.FOR: The person with whom any such arrangement is made
section-2-10.TO: himself be a person who already has parental responsibility for the child concerned

section-3-5.FOR: A person who— (a) does not have parental responsibility for a particular child; but (b) has care of the child
section-3-5.TO: do what is reasonable in all the circumstances of the case
section-3-5.FOR_2: the purpose of safeguarding or promoting the child’s welfare

section-4-1B.TO: by order amend subsection (1A) so as to add further enactments to the list in that subsection

section-4-3.TO: make an order under subsection (2A) on the application— (a) of any person who has parental responsibility for the child; or (b) with the leave of the court, of the child himself
section-4-3.SUBJECT TO: in the case of parental responsibility acquired under subsection (1)(c), section 12(4)

section-4-4.ONLY IF: it is satisfied that the child has sufficient understanding to make the proposed application

section-4A-1.FOR: a child’s parent (“parent A”) or, if the other parent of the child also has parental responsibility for the child, both parents
section-4A-1.TO: by agreement with a person who is not the child’s parent (“the step-parent”) provide for the step-parent to have parental responsibility for the child
section-4A-1.WHERE: parent A who has parental responsibility for the child is married to, or a civil partner of, the step-parent

section-4A-1.TO: order that a person who is not a child’s parent (“the step-parent”) shall have parental responsibility for the child
section-4A-1.WHERE: a child’s parent (“parent A”) who has parental responsibility for the child is married to, or a civil partner of, the step-parent

section-4A-3.FOR: a parental responsibility agreement under subsection (1)(a), or an order under subsection (1)(b)
section-4A-3.ONLY BY: an order of the court made on the application— (a) of any person who has parental responsibility for the child; or (b) with the leave of the court, of the child himself

section-4A-4.ONLY IF: it is satisfied that the child has sufficient understanding to make the proposed application

section-4ZA-3.TO: by order amend subsection (2) so as to add further enactments to the list in that subsection

section-4ZA-6.TO: make an order under subsection (5) on the application— (a) of any person who has parental responsibility for the child; or (b) with the leave of the court, of the child himself
section-4ZA-6.SUBJECT TO: in the case of parental responsibility acquired under subsection (1)(c), section 12(4)

section-4ZA-7.ONLY IF: it is satisfied that the child has sufficient understanding to make the proposed application

section-5-1.TO: by order appoint any individual to be a child’s guardian
section-5-1.WHERE: an application with respect to the child is made to the court by the individual
section-5-1.IF: — (a) the child has no parent with parental responsibility for him; or (b) a parent, guardian or special guardian of the child's was named in a child arrangements order as a person with whom the child was to live and has died while the order was in force; or (c) paragraph (b) does not apply, and the child’s only or last surviving special guardian dies

section-5-2.TO: be exercised in any family proceedings
section-5-2.IF: the court considers that the order should be made even though no application has been made for it

section-5-3.FOR: A parent who has parental responsibility for his child
section-5-3.TO: appoint another individual to be the child’s guardian in the event of his death

section-5-4.TO: appoint another individual to take his place as the child’s guardian in the event of his death

section-5-4.FOR: a special guardian of a child
section-5-4.TO: appoint another individual to be the child’s guardian in the event of his death

section-5-11.TO: exercise the High Court’s inherent jurisdiction to appoint a guardian of the estate of any child
section-5-11.SUBJECT TO: any provision made by rules of court

section-5-12.TO: prescribe the circumstances in which, and conditions subject to which, an appointment of such a guardian may be made

section-6-5.FOR: a person who is appointed as a guardian under section 5(3) or (4)
section-6-5.TO: disclaim his appointment by an instrument in writing signed by him and made within a reasonable time of his first knowing that the appointment has taken effect

section-6-7.FOR: Any appointment of a guardian under section 5
section-6-7.TO: be brought to an end at any time by order of the court
section-6-7.ON: the application of any person who has parental responsibility for the child

section-6-7.FOR: Any appointment of a guardian under section 5
section-6-7.TO: be brought to an end at any time by order of the court
section-6-7.ON: the application of the child concerned, with leave of the court

section-6-7.FOR: Any appointment of a guardian under section 5
section-6-7.TO: be brought to an end at any time by order of the court
section-6-7.IF: the court considers that it should be brought to an end even though no application has been made

section-7-1.FOR: A court considering any question with respect to a child under this Act
section-7-1.TO: — (a) ask an officer of the Service or a Welsh family proceedings officer; or — (b) ask a local authority to arrange for— (i) an officer of the authority; or (ii) such other person (other than an officer of the Service or a Welsh family proceedings officer) as the authority considers appropriate, to report to the court on such matters relating to the welfare of that child as are required to be dealt with in the report

section-7-2.TO: make regulations specifying matters which, unless the court orders otherwise, must be dealt with in any report under this section

section-7-3.TO: be made in writing, or orally, as the court requires

section-7-4.TO: Regardless of any enactment or rule of law which would otherwise prevent it from doing so, take account of— (a) any statement contained in the report; and (b) any evidence given in respect of the matters referred to in the report
section-7-4.IN SO FAR AS: the statement or evidence is, in the opinion of the court, relevant to the question which it is considering

section-7-5.FOR: the authority or officer of the Service or a Welsh family proceedings officer
section-7-5.TO: comply with any request for a report under this section

section-7-6.TO: nominate a judicial office holder (as defined in section 109(4) of the Constitutional Reform Act 2005) to exercise his functions under subsection (2)
